fields.title: ProcureTT notice record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _noticeType/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Payload fields are keyed by ProcureTT's own column labels verbatim, and differ by _noticeType -- the fields below cover all five notice types.

_noticeType.title: Notice type
_noticeType.description: tenders, awards, asppa, prequalification, or disposals.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-html-table (listing only), S1-html-detail (listing + per-entry detail page, when fetchDetail=true), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (zero rows for this notice type) or blocked_or_transient (network/upstream issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_entryId.title: Entry ID
_entryId.description: ProcureTT's internal Gravity Forms entry id for this row, or null when this notice type has no per-entry detail page (awards, asppa).

_detail.title: Detail page fields
_detail.description: Present only when input fetchDetail=true and this notice type has a detail page (tenders, prequalification, disposals). A superset of the listing columns, keyed by the detail page's own field labels -- e.g. tenders add 'Notice Type', 'Date of Issuance', 'Lines of Business (Level 4)' (precise UNSPSC codes), and 'Submission Deadline Time'. Null if the detail fetch failed (_detailError set alongside).

_detailError.title: Detail fetch error
_detailError.description: Present only when fetchDetail=true and the per-entry detail request failed for this specific row -- the listing fields are still returned.

Public Body.title: Public body
Public Body.description: All notice types. The government ministry/agency/state enterprise that published this notice.

Tender Reference No..title: Tender reference number
Tender Reference No..description: tenders only. ProcureTT's own tender reference, e.g. 'ITB#5/2026' or a bare numeric id.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: tenders and awards. Free-text notice description. On 'awards', can be '...'-truncated with no detail page to recover the full text (a genuine upstream limitation, not a parsing gap).

Submission Deadline Date.title: Submission deadline date
Submission Deadline Date.description: tenders only. DD/MM/YYYY as rendered by ProcureTT.

Lines of Business (Level 3).title: Lines of business (UNSPSC level 3)
Lines of Business (Level 3).description: tenders, prequalification, disposals (as 'Disposal Categories'). Array of 'code description' strings from ProcureTT's own bulleted list.

Disposal Categories.title: Disposal categories
Disposal Categories.description: disposals only. Same shape as 'Lines of Business (Level 3)'.

Award Value (TTD).title: Award value (TTD)
Award Value (TTD).description: awards only. Trinidad and Tobago Dollars, as stated in the column header.

Award Date.title: Award date
Award Date.description: awards only. Observed in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format, unlike every other date field on this platform (which render DD/MM/YYYY) -- verified against source, not a parsing artifact.

Tender Notice Document.title: Tender notice document
Tender Notice Document.description: tenders only. {text, url} -- direct, no-login PDF download link.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all five notice types.
